lines.text: In the region of Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asks who people say He is, and the disciples name John the Baptist, Elijah, and Jeremiah.
Simon Peter answers that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus says Peter's Father in heaven revealed this to him.
Jesus says He will build His church on this rock, and He tells the disciples to tell no one He is the Christ.
Jesus says He must suffer in Jerusalem and be killed, and Peter rebukes Him, so Jesus calls Peter a stumbling block.
Jesus says anyone who follows Him must take up his sword, and the Son of Man will come with His angels.
